tested_scope: Narrow transport primitive only: use the Chat-exposed authenticated GitHub repository Contents API to persist and read back lightweight state/evidence in an ordinary repository file. This does not test hosted compute, Actions, Codespaces, artifacts, LFS, packages, external APIs/models, protected-primary execution, or general Work-outcome parity.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs: REST API endpoints for repository contents / Create or update file contents
primary_sources.verified_fact: The endpoint creates a new file or replaces an existing repository file; updating requires the current blob SHA; write permission is Contents(write); conflicting content mutations must be serialized.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs: Rate limits for the REST API
primary_sources.verified_fact: REST access is governed by time-window primary and secondary rate limits rather than a monthly request allowance; authenticated-user requests are generally 5,000 per hour, and rate-limit exhaustion returns 403/429 with reset/retry guidance.

exact_chat_repository_evidence.read_evidence: This invocation successfully fetched the current note control files and exact Git blob identities through the connected GitHub repository surface.
exact_chat_repository_evidence.write_path_probe: This audit file itself is the single bounded write probe. A subsequent exact same-path readback is required before the slice is credited.

hard_gate_assessment.rate_limit_dependency: time-window rate limits exist and are not a pass-through completion condition; the route must checkpoint and resume on a later invocation rather than wait/retry in-run.
hard_gate_assessment.repository_storage_scope: ordinary lightweight Git repository state/evidence transport only, explicitly permitted by the current repository_transport_rule; no LFS/artifact/package storage allowance is used.
